integrity: Proof and tests are given in RESULT.md and verify.py. Finite-field tests do not certify characteristic-zero arguments. Possible equivalent unlocated prior literature remains an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The cubed Klein quadric in characteristic zero only; reduced singular support and generic transverse types, not the full nonreduced Jacobian scheme or nongeneric intersections. The sextic equation and its degree are consistent with, and are not claimed to supersede, the general coordinatewise-power theory of Dey, Görlach and Kaihnsa.
title: Four singular strata and a nonnormal divisor on the cubed Klein quadric
